scope: Read-only OS dependency primitive. No MCP tool registration, complete binary_read/view replacement, configured host authorization or whole-runtime closure is claimed.

executable.input_transport: Repeated u64 little-endian byte length followed by that many request bytes; 112..4207 bytes per request
executable.output_transport: Repeated u64 little-endian byte length followed by a complete response; 128..65664 bytes per response
executable.shutdown: EOF at a frame boundary asks HIA to close the root handle; truncated frames fail. No response is published before file identity and close checks finish.

exit_status.64: invalid startup root or failed root admission

authority.root_source: Only startup argv from the administrator; no request field can change the root
authority.root_custody: The startup directory is opened component by component with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and retained as an opaque descriptor capability until EOF. Requests use that same inode even if its old pathname is renamed or replaced.
authority.original_behavior_distinction: The retained binary_file.py helper reopens parent directories from / for each request. This primitive intentionally pins startup root custody. Its root-replacement behavior is explicitly tested and must be reconciled by the eventual caller authorization owner before tool replacement.
authority.path_profile: Valid UTF-8 absolute paths of at most 4095 bytes, without NUL or any .. component. Dot and redundant slash components normalize like PurePosixPath, including its distinct exactly-two-leading-slash anchor. The root itself and final names beginning .hepta- are refused.
authority.symlinks: O_NOFOLLOW on every opened path component, including the final file
authority.hardlinks: Ordinary read targets may have multiple links, matching the retained read helper. This is not a filesystem sandbox against external writers or privileged namespace changes.

request.absent_version: All seven version words must be zero when has_expected_version=0

response.payload: Successful read bytes only; every failed response has empty data and zero file metadata
response.version_semantics: The before/after descriptor version preserves the retained dev/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns identity without narrowing seconds*1e9. Seconds retain signed two-complement bits. atime is intentionally excluded.

policy_entry.signature: f0(readbuf input, mutbuf output, mutbuf workspace)->u32
policy_entry.startup: A fresh zeroed workspace receives the administrator root UTF-8 bytes. The adapter reenters with unchanged input until HIA returns zero.
policy_entry.requests: The adapter reenters with the same unchanged request until a complete response is returned. A zero-length input at an idle initialized state denotes transport-owned shutdown.

continuation.sequence: Strictly increases across startup and all requests; the adapter independently checks it. At most 8192 effects may run for one startup/request/shutdown frame.

actions.1: open / once for startup at sequence 1

continuation.handles: Eight private adapter slots carry fd plus 56-bit generation. HIA receives generation<<8 | (slot+1), never a raw fd. Unknown, released or mismatched-generation handles are rejected.

buffer_admission.component: Only workspace offset 12288, extent 2..4096 including terminal NUL; no earlier NUL, slash, . or .. component
buffer_admission.pread: A nonempty extent at most 4096 wholly inside workspace[16384,81920); signed nonnegative file offset

continuation.interrupts: openat/fstat/pread/read/write retry EINTR. close is issued once and its handle is retired before the syscall. SIGPIPE is ignored so output failure becomes exit 74.
continuation.cleanup: HIA closes request file/intermediate directory handles before any response and closes its root on EOF. The adapter also closes every still-tracked handle on fatal exits. The kernel releases remaining descriptors on process teardown. Handles remain private to one process.
